create-lifetime-task-avd.py.source:
from pathlib import Path

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "android-avd"
name = "OneMapU25F05"
avd = base / (name + ".avd")
metadata = base / (name + ".ini")
assert not avd.exists() and not metadata.exists(), "Task AVD already exists"
source = Path("/Users/rob/.android/avd/Medium_Phone.avd/config.ini")
values = dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in source.read_text().splitlines() if "=" in line)
values.update({"AvdId": name, "avd.ini.displayname": name, "disk.dataPartition.size": "2G", "sdcard.size": "128M", "hw.ramSize": "2048", "fastboot.forceFastBoot": "no", "fastboot.forceColdBoot": "yes", "fastboot.forceChosenSnapshotBoot": "no", "image.sysdir.1": "system-images/android-37.0/google_apis_playstore/arm64-v8a/", "target": "android-37.0"})
avd.mkdir(parents=True)
(avd / "config.ini").write_text("".join(key + "=" + value + "\n" for key, value in values.items()))
metadata.write_text("avd.ini.encoding=UTF-8\npath=" + str(avd) + "\ntarget=android-37.0\n")

launch-lifetime-emulator.py.source:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

log_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
arguments = ["emulator", "-avd", "OneMapU25F05", "-port", "5580", "-no-window", "-no-audio", "-no-snapshot", "-no-boot-anim", "-memory", "2048", "-gpu", "auto"]
with log_path.open("xb") as output:
    process = subprocess.Popen(arguments, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    try:
        exit_code = process.wait(timeout=1)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        print(json.dumps({"pid": process.pid, "pgid": process.pid, "log": str(log_path)}))
    else:
        raise SystemExit(exit_code or 1)
